preconditions.description: The number of integers n must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b_i < 2**60 for b_i in b)
preconditions.description: Each integer b_i in the sequence must be between 1 and 2^60 - 1.
The length of the sequence b must be equal to n.

postconditions.description: If no valid permutation exists, output 'No'. Otherwise, output 'Yes' followed by the valid permutation of integers.

postconditions.expression: all(a_i < a_{i+1} for i in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: The sequence a_i must be strictly increasing.
The unordered multisets of b and b_prime must be equal.
